purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The Ordos Natural Resources Bureau publishes a Dongsheng/Kangbashi land-registration guide and the Ordos city government service portal lists real-property registration services. The Dongsheng guide’s cadastral-map retrieval is tied to scanning a property-certificate QR code through an official account, so it does not establish an anonymous geometry route. This is city/district-bound custody evidence, not evidence that the WUP point or the wider city has open parcel geometry.
